verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਮੁਰੀਦੁ ਨ ਗਲੀ ਹੋਵਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: muradhaa hoi mureedh na galee hovanaa|

en.bdb: Only by becoming dead in life, i.e. totally detached, and not through mere verbal jargon one can become a true disciple.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਬਰੁ ਸਿਦਕਿ ਸਹੀਦੁ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਖੋਵਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: saabar sidhak saheedh bharam bhau khovanaa|

en.bdb: One could be such a person only after getting sacrificed for truth and contentment and by eschewing delusions and fears.
The true disciple is a boughten slave who is ever busy in the service of the Master.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਖਾਣਾ ਸੋਵਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: naa tis bhukh na needh na khaanaa sovanaa|

en.bdb: He forgets hunger, sleep, food and rest.
He  grinds fresh flour (for free kitchen) and serves by fetching water.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਖੇ ਦੀ ਤਾਗੀਦ ਪਗ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: pakhe dhee taageedh pag mal dhovanaa|

en.bdb: He fans (the congregation) and washes nicely the feet of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਜੀਦੁ ਨ ਹਸਣੁ ਰੋਵਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: sevak hoi sa(n)jeedh na hasan rovanaa|

en.bdb: The servant  always remains disciplined and has nothing to do with wailing and laughing.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰ ਦਰਵੇਸ ਰਸੀਦੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਵਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhar dharaves raseedh piram ras bhovanaa|

en.bdb: This way he becomes dervish at the door of the Lord and gets drenched in the delights of the rains of love.
He will be seen as the first moon of Id day (which the Muslims eagerly wait for in order to break their long fasts), and only he will come out as a perfect man.
